name: locate-function
purpose: Find where the function, method or class a request in words concerns is defined: a local model picks the name (pick-function, held to a definition the file has), then py-outline gives its signature and exact line span.
examples: where is the function that retries the upload
locate the method this bug report concerns in app.py
which lines does the code for computing the total span

path.description: the Python file, relative to the worktree

description.description: what the function does, or what is wrong with it, in words
